// Package sealedprobe is copied by
// TestReversibilityIsSealedToThisPackage's build-probe sub-test
// (internal/migrate/step_test.go) into a temporary directory under
// internal/migrate/ and built with `go build .` (PA-2). It declares its own
// type with its own method named isReversibility and asserts that type
// satisfies migrate.Reversibility. The assertion below MUST fail to
// compile: Go's identity for an unexported method includes the declaring
// package, so a method named isReversibility declared in package
// sealedprobe is a DIFFERENT method from the one migrate.Reversibility
// names, even though the name and empty signature match exactly. An
// observed build failure naming isReversibility is the strong half of the
// seal proof; a successful build here would mean the seal is open.
package sealedprobe

import "github.com/seanb4t/engram/internal/migrate"

type fake struct{}

func (fake) isReversibility() {}

var _ migrate.Reversibility = fake{}
